name: cascade-headless-cloudflare-example
description: Turn build123d Python into STEP/BREP/STL inside a Cloudflare Worker, using cascade-core headless. Two flavors: build123d-lite (default) and verbatim upstream build123d 0.11.1 (--env upstream).

scripts.dev:upstream: npm run prepare-assets && wrangler dev --env upstream
scripts.deploy:upstream: npm run prepare-assets && wrangler deploy --env upstream
